claim: Only observed supported HtoD source byte copies + successful API/unchanged host bytes + observed completion boundary. This is not a full CUDA initial-state snapshot.

coverage.kernel_argument_bank0_bytes: NOT_CAPTURED; source/argv/declared launch-argument initialization rule required. Trace captures symbolic bank0 accesses, not scalar argument values.
coverage.cuMemset: NOT_CAPTURED; fixed pattern/size source rule required, otherwise INITIALIZATION_COVERAGE_PENDING
coverage.D2D: NOT_CAPTURED_AS_EXTERNAL_BYTES; complete device dataflow and initial-source rules required; no content claim from source-byte capsule alone
coverage.managed_or_mapped_host_memory: UNSUPPORTED; no observed HtoD cannot prove its host writes
coverage.symbol_upload: Only when lowered to an actually observed supported HtoD v2 call; raw bytes and destination pointer recorded. Constant65 proves its256B table upload, not all symbol mechanisms. Source/global-symbol rule needed; destination VA is not symbolic constant bank identity.
coverage.array_2D_3D_generic_batch_copy: UNSUPPORTED_INPUT_API_OR_CALLBACK_COVERAGE; source preflight must exclude even APIs not observable by NVBit1.7.5

mandatory_asset_metadata: UM/mapped/GL/external initialization flags must be ABSENT for this profile
symbol upload lowering/provenance rule or NONE_IN_SOURCE
unknown initialization coverage => INITIALIZATION_COVERAGE_PENDING, no full-input qualification
async host-source unchanged/allocated from API return to completion: per-asset source rule
single context lifetime and source launch-count oracle; journal count is not proof of unobservable mechanisms
numerical_and_identity: Same instrumented application reference is independent; source-byte capsule alone gives no numerical qualification. Native-observer comparison uses actual per-copy SHA and reports INPUT_DIFF, never assumed equivalence.
observer_timing: Native observer loads NVBit and retains original producer prelaunch synchronization; it is not a pure unloaded or timing-equivalent baseline.
